TrackCustodyProjection records deterministic custody state (Held vs Dropped), drop cause (LostSensor, Stale, CommsDenied, ExplicitDrop, Unknown), and transition ledger.

requirements.summary: Absent: no Weather, Precipitation, CloudCover, or Visibility model in src/; envMask is RCS-driven (PhaseBCatalogDetectionModifier). ScenarioSeaState exists only as Douglas 0-9 scalar in BoatOps.
acceptance_criteria: Authorable deterministic weather/sea-state model modulating sensor detection (radar/EO/IR), small-craft mobility, and weapon employment without breaking golden hashes unless gated.

requirements.title: Terrain, bathymetry, coastline & geometric radar-horizon LOS
requirements.summary: Partially addressed (LineOfSight.cs / ENV-02 DRG-379 landed deterministic authored radar-horizon + terrain profile LOS masking), while full DEM terrain, bathymetry, coastline/land-mask, and submarine depth/bottom constraints remain absent.
acceptance_criteria: Full theater bathymetry, coastline/land-mask, and terrain/bottom constraints integrated with detection and movement loops.

requirements.title: Acoustic environment (thermocline, CZ, SSP, reverberation)
requirements.summary: Absent: zero thermocline, convergence zone, sound-speed profile, or acoustic propagation layers; ASW resolves on basic range/Pd.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic acoustic propagation model with layer depth, convergence zones, and depth-dependent detection tested against ASW fixtures.

requirements.title: Day/night cycle and ambient illumination model
requirements.summary: Absent: zero time-of-day, daylight, or illumination simulation in src/ (only MapLayerId UI toggle exists).
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic time-of-day/illumination state affecting EO/IR detection, visual ID timing, and night-attack profiles.

requirements.title: Soft-kill expendable countermeasures (chaff, flares, decoys)
requirements.summary: Absent in main engagement pipeline: defence is hard-kill (pkIntercept) + jammers/spoofTracks; no chaff/flare/decoy expendables (SwarmSoftKill is swarm-specific EMP/jam only).
acceptance_criteria: Expendable countermeasures tracked in magazines and evaluated deterministically during missile/engagement resolution.

requirements.title: Torpedo defence (anti-torpedo countermeasures, towed decoys, evasion)
requirements.summary: Absent: zero anti-torpedo countermeasures, towed decoys, or torpedo-evasion modeling (interacts with GAP-05).
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic torpedo defence / countermeasure / evasion evaluation integrated into subsurface engagement resolver.

requirements.title: Weapon kinematics and multi-tick time of flight
requirements.summary: Absent: MvpEngagementResolver.Resolve resolves engagements instantaneously in launch tick; no flight time, trajectory, or seeker-lock lifecycle (DRG-344 documents boundary).
acceptance_criteria: Separate ADR + multi-tick weapon flight lifecycle supporting in-flight intercept, shoot-look-shoot doctrine, and replay determinism.

requirements.title: Carrier, amphibious, and flight-deck operations
requirements.summary: Absent: no flight-deck cycle, sortie generation limits, or amphibious landing modeling (AirOpsFsm models basic state map only, not deck cycles).
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic deck-cycle / sortie-rate / amphibious constraints governing air/boat availability.

requirements.title: Catalog per-platform EMCON profile data (platform_emcon empty)
requirements.summary: Partial: scenario-level emcon override works, but platform_emcon & catalog_staging_emcon DB tables have 0 rows (BUG-catalog-emcon-tables-empty.md Status: Open).
acceptance_criteria: Sourced per-platform EMCON profiles populated via CatalogWriteGate propose/approve so catalog EMCON queries succeed.

requirements.title: Progressive damage control, flooding & repair-over-time
requirements.summary: Partial: CatalogDamageWithdrawEngageGate models binary/state engage eligibility & withdrawal, but no progressive flooding, fire, damage control, or repair over time.
acceptance_criteria: Progressive damage-control/flooding/repair model deterministically affecting speed, readiness, and survivability.
